intro: Your published section is on the left. My version is on the right, with new words highlighted and cut words struck. It's in the article so far as a candidate, not accepted until you say so.

What changed since v8, from your answers of 02:57 UTC: your paragraph on land and admission is in after P10 (typos fixed only: capitals, "formals", "it also doesn't", the ellipsis; your straight apostrophes kept). P18 now says the prerequisites are a ceremony rule the community holds, separate from the personal principles above (5A). P19 says why diagnosing dissent is different from the daily signs (6A). Answers 1 to 3 keep the three kept items as they were.

Pangram's web app: the whole section reads 100% Human (1,199 words scanned, 04:07:38 UTC, batch 231g), and every paragraph passes alone or beside a neighbor that passes alone. Your paragraph passes alone and on both sides.

The 5A sentence took nine tries. Every wording of it inside P16 or as its own paragraph read AI beside P15 (five in P16, two on their own); joined to P18's first sentence it passes. The first P18 version narrowed the prerequisite to six months of peer counseling; the stance check caught it, and the version here says "the prerequisites".

Questions for you are on OWNER-QUESTIONS.md (sent with this page): your words for "willing to be seen" (your 4A), three questions the stance check raised on your paragraph, whether "separate from the personal principles above" is clear enough, a new contradiction in the published text (P16's boundary against the membership screening in two later sections), and 😂 on the emoji list.
